answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through acoustic multipath attestation across outdoor sensor arrays. A node emits a calibrated chirp and analyzes the reverberant echo reflected by local terrain during the signal's outward voyage. Attackers incur the verifiable hardware and geographic deployment cost of discrete acoustic transceivers per identity. However, environmental noise, such as the call of a nearby sparrow, distorts reflection patterns and causes false rejections.
